verdict.rationale: Paxos documents programmatic stablecoin transfers: v2.0 API asset transfers, a mint orchestration that converts USD to stablecoins and transfers in one call, and on-chain stablecoin refunds. Status tracking is documented through Get Transfer and List Transfers polling workflows, plus orchestration webhooks that fire on each status transition. Missing for 10: an explicit crypto-withdrawal endpoint to an external wallet address, any stored-recipient/address-book capability, documented transfer status states through final on-chain settlement, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
